messages.subject: Unitrace copy label and timing semantics documented
messages.body: I traced the pinned unitrace classifier, Level Zero allocation queries, context-copy edge cases, and timing/size aggregation in the <=9KB report. H2D/M2D/S2D describe queried allocation types, not physical PCIe payload or residency; the aggregate reports start/end service time and counts, with per-size labels but no byte sum, while MemoryCopyRegion has a zero-size source bug. The report gives a bounded source/payload/dependency attribution recipe and states the extra link evidence needed for a PCIe bottleneck claim; no execution or implementation work was done.
